defect: a changing multibit bus is synchronized one bit at a time without a data-stability protocol
rationale: bus_a can change independently of clk_b, and independently synchronized bits can represent different source words at bus_b.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Each bit of a 4-bit bus is synchronised independently with no qualifier or Gray coding, so the captured word can be incoherent.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the multibit destination sampling context but reduced the consistency-control machinery to four scalar receiving pipelines in a self-contained top module.

mutation.description: Connected each bus bit to its own two-flop synchronizer and assembled bus_b without a bundled-data or handshake guarantee.
